Figure 19.7 Megaloblastic Anemia
Late-stage immature red blood cells from the bone marrow are shown. This is usually seen in folate deﬁ ciency that 
impedes DNA synthesis in the marrow. Alternatively, this could be caused by a consecutive cyanocobalamin deﬁ ciency 
or by treatment with a drug (such as methotrexate, which is given to patients with certain forms of cancer and other 
disease states) that inhibits DNA synthesis.
